name: meaningfy-navigator
description: See who runs what and where the work stands in Claude Code: a status line and band over the session, workflow and plan drift warnings, hygiene prompts, and actions that run your own commands (Claude Code only, CLI and desktop)

band.title: Band
band.description: How the band above the prompt starts each session: unfolded, folded or hidden. /navigator band changes it for the session.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show navigator's line in the status bar at session start. /navigator line changes it for the session.
